mapper.select: SELECT * FROM FOOD_API_TBL WHERE FOOD_NAME LIKE '%'||#{keyword}||'%' ORDER BY FOOD_NAME ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DIET_TBL ( DIET_NO, USER_NO, DIET_DATE, DIET_TYPE, FOOD_NAMES, FOOD_CD, AMOUNT, KCAL ) VALUES ( SEQ_DIET_NONEXTVAL.NEXTVAL, #{userNo}, NVL(#{dietDate}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), #{dietType}, #{foodNames}, #{foodCd}, #{amount}, #{kcal} )
mapper.select: SELECT DIET_TYPE AS "dietType", COALESCE(SUM(KCAL),0) AS "totalKcal" FROM DIET_TBL WHERE DIET_DATE = #{dietDate} AND USER_NO = #{userNo} GROUP BY DIET_TYPE

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(d.KCAL), 0) AS "totalKcal", COALESCE(SUM( NVL(f.CARB,0) * (CASE WHEN NVL(f.SERVING_SIZE,0) = 0 THEN NVL(d.AMOUNT,1) ELSE NVL(d.AMOUNT,0) / f.SERVING_SIZE END) ), 0) AS "totalCarb", COALESCE(SUM( NVL(f.PROTEIN,0) * (CASE WHEN NVL(f.SERVING_SIZE,0) = 0 THEN NVL(d.AMOUNT,1) ELSE NVL(d.AMOUNT,0) / f.SERVING_SIZE END) ), 0) AS "totalProtein", COALESCE(SUM( NVL(f.FAT,0) * (CASE WHEN NVL(f.SERVING_SIZE,0) = 0 THEN NVL(d.AMOUNT,1) ELSE NVL(d.AMOUNT,0) / f.SERVING_SIZE END) ), 0) AS "totalFat" FROM DIET_TBL d LEFT JOIN FOOD_API_TBL f ON d.FOOD_CD = f.FOOD_CD WHERE d.DIET_DATE = #{dietDate} AND d.USER_NO = #{userNo}

SELECT d.DIET_NO AS "dietNo", d.DIET_DATE AS "dietDate", d.DIET_TYPE AS "dietType", d.FOOD_NAMES AS "foodNames", d.FOOD_CD AS "foodCd", COALESCE(d.AMOUNT, 0) AS "amount", COALESCE(d.KCAL, 0) AS "kcal", COALESCE(f.CARB,0) * (CASE WHEN NVL(f.SERVING_SIZE,0) = 0 THEN NVL(d.AMOUNT,1) ELSE NVL(d.AMOUNT,0) / f.SERVING_SIZE END) AS "carb", COALESCE(f.PROTEIN,0) * (CASE WHEN NVL(f.SERVING_SIZE,0) = 0 THEN NVL(d.AMOUNT,1) ELSE NVL(d.AMOUNT,0) / f.SERVING_SIZE END) AS "protein", COALESCE(f.FAT,0) * (CASE WHEN NVL(f.SERVING_SIZE,0) = 0 THEN NVL(d.AMOUNT,1) ELSE NVL(d.AMOUNT,0) / f.SERVING_SIZE END) AS "fat" FROM DIET_TBL d LEFT JOIN FOOD_API_TBL f ON d.FOOD_CD = f.FOOD_CD WHERE d.DIET_DATE = #{dietDate} AND d.DIET_TYPE = #{dietType} AND d.USER_NO = #{userNo} ORDER BY d.DIET_NO ASC
